_about: Frances Hodgson Burnett's (1849-1924) children's books: The Secret Garden (1911), A Little Princess (1905) with its first form Sara Crewe (1888), Little Lord Fauntleroy (1886), The Lost Prince (1915), Racketty-Packetty House (1906) and Little Saint Elizabeth and Other Stories (1890). Clean Gutenberg text; US public domain. Added at the coordinator's standing relay (2026-10-02: choose public-domain storytellers batches; Adam may veto).

burnett-little-saint-elizabeth: Little Saint Elizabeth and Other Stories (1890)
